copy.curiosityHook: Can an affinity with swarming insects uncover the predator stalking an elite European boarding school?
copy.description: Transferred to a remote Swiss boarding school, an American girl with a strange ability to communicate with insects finds herself drawn into an investigation when a string of brutal murders shakes the campus.
copy.vibeSummary: Eerie and suspenseful, with an offbeat premise and steady, engaged investigative pacing best suited for a solitary night.
copy.whyWatch: Directed by Dario Argento, this horror-thriller balances an uncanny supernatural gift against the steadily mounting suspense of a gruesome murder mystery.
